translation: In taking these, use the filiform needle; first press above, and only after it responds to the hand for a long time, then needle and give [the treatment]. What it treats: headache, dizziness, and falling, abdominal pain, fullness, sudden distension, and pain from newly accumulated [masses]. The Suwen Jutong Lun (Discussion of Pain) says: When cold qi lodges in the Chong vessel, the Chong vessel arises at Guanyuan (CV4) and ascends straight along the abdomen.
